sections.title: Overview report
sections.content:
Go to the Dashboard menu and click the "Overview" report:

![](/uploads/2f358ff5f048ae1d0acd30c2.png)

The overview reports currently available in the system:

![](/uploads/d07d9445cb6fe20d9e55a482.png)

To see the matching records, click the report name and then click View List, or click:

![](/uploads/c4615c7d3e1315cdcf45ba59.png)

![](/uploads/3fc8eb65e18903b2787781e5.png)

To export a report to PDF, click the camera icon to capture the report and export it as a PDF:

![](/uploads/565b7bd5b3d75a2f6684c3ed.png)

To export a report to Excel, click the report name and then click Export Excel:

![](/uploads/627c7e39200ad5f8602046c4.png)

sections.title: Revenue overview
sections.content:
On the main menu bar, select Freight charges. In the list of functions, select 'Overview':

![](/uploads/e53c71ab01fe7bc8d6235a4a.png)
![](/uploads/89d243059fbba27cf4a0c706.png)

Exporting the revenue data to Excel:
- On the Revenue overview screen, find the table whose data you want to export.
- Click the arrow icon in the top right corner of the table.
- Select Export Excel.
The system generates an Excel file with the data of the selected table and downloads it to your device.

![](/uploads/a1c3e558071aebba6cdbf7d1.png)

sections.content:
Go to the Dashboard menu and click the "Cost report":
